question: can cost-based refinements (A2 camera count in cost, A12 explicit no-link cost, A13 look-ahead for contested links) matter?
verdict: A2/A12/A13 CLOSED without implementation: only 2.7% (sparse) to 5.6% (4x density) of tracks face a contested decision, the average track has about ONE candidate (0.97 / 0.78), so no cost, no-link cost or look-ahead can change more than a few percent of links; the cost weighting measured above is identical to the baseline. Tracks fail by having no candidate (22% at 4x density), not by competition.
